profile.Name: Commodore Thomas
profile.Personality: Pushy and blustering, he presses every newcomer to help drive off the Natives and turns hostile on anyone who refuses.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Herdsmen from Buck in Okran's Valley. His people need pasture for their cattle, and he blames the Natives for harassing them and their herd.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Opens by calling a newcomer "outlander" three times over. Calls the Natives savages and taunts anyone who refuses him as afraid of them.
